metadata.title: Cancer Medicine Philippines – FDA Oncology Distributor
metadata.description: FDA-approved cancer medicine Philippines distributor. Chemotherapy, immunotherapy, & hospital drugs. Trusted by 500+ hospitals. Cold-chain delivery nationwide.

corp.h1: Cancer Medicine Philippines: FDA-Approved Chemotherapy & Hospital Pharmaceutical Supplier
corp.intro: At Getmeds Philippines Inc. and 2MG Inc., we understand that a box of medicine isn't a product. It's a stage-IV oncology mother in Cebu waiting for her next dose. Operating under the unified identity of the Bishnoi Omniverse, we are SEC-registered and FDA-licensed oncology distributors in the Philippines dedicated to ensuring that distance, cost, and logistics never decide who lives.

metadata.title: Oncology Exporter India – WHO-GMP Cancer Drugs Export
metadata.description: Leading oncology exporter in India. Exporting WHO-GMP certified cancer medicines, carboplatin, & specialty pharmaceuticals to 54+ countries worldwide.

llp.badge: Bishnoi Omniverse • India Global Export LLP
llp.h1: Oncology Exporter India: WHO-GMP Cancer Drugs & Pharmaceutical Export Worldwide
llp.intro: Getmeds Healthcare (India LLP) is a premier oncology exporter in India and the global sourcing and wholesale export hub of the Bishnoi Omniverse. Operating from Mumbai, Maharashtra, India, we bridge world-class pharmaceutical manufacturing with healthcare systems, distributors, and hospitals across 54+ countries.

introduction.body1: Bishnoi Omniverse represents a broader ecosystem built around entrepreneurship, innovation, healthcare, international collaboration, and long-term value creation.
introduction.body2: Rather than being defined by a single industry or market, the Omniverse brings together different ventures and initiatives under a shared identity — creating connections between people, businesses, ideas, and opportunities.

healthcareHighlight.title: Healthcare at the Heart of the Journey.
healthcareHighlight.body1: Healthcare represents one of the strongest operating stories within the Bishnoi ecosystem.
healthcareHighlight.body2: Through Getmeds, the ecosystem has developed healthcare and pharmaceutical activities connecting patients, pharmacies, hospitals, healthcare professionals, suppliers, and international pharmaceutical partners.
healthcareHighlight.body3: Getmeds Philippines focuses on pharmaceutical distribution and healthcare access across the Philippines, with publicly documented activities covering areas including oncology, hematology, rare diseases, essential medicines, biologicals, vaccines, and medical devices.
healthcareHighlight.body4: Getmeds Healthcare extends the pharmaceutical network internationally through sourcing, exports, named-patient supply, cold-chain logistics, and pharmaceutical distribution.

globalPresence.title: Connected Across Borders.
globalPresence.body1: The ecosystem's publicly referenced network connects India, the Philippines, Southeast Asia, Vanuatu, Latin markets, and international pharmaceutical supply networks.
globalPresence.body2: Our global vision is not simply about being present in more countries.

leadershipTeaser.title: Driven by Entrepreneurship.
leadershipTeaser.body1: The story behind the ecosystem is closely connected to entrepreneur Naresh Bishnoi and the development of Getmeds.
leadershipTeaser.body2: His publicly documented journey from Haryana, India, to building a healthcare business in the Philippines reflects a broader philosophy of entrepreneurship, resilience, and creating opportunities beyond geographical boundaries.
leadershipTeaser.quote: Dreams do not have an address.

impact.title: Growth With Purpose.
impact.body1: Business growth creates its greatest value when it contributes to something beyond business itself.
impact.body2: The ecosystem's publicly documented healthcare and community initiatives include patient-access programs, healthcare assistance, community partnerships, and initiatives focused on improving access to medicines.

sustainability.title: Responsible Growth.
sustainability.body1: Responsible business is an important part of the ecosystem's long-term direction.
sustainability.body2: Getmeds has publicly identified its participation in the United Nations Global Compact and has communicated its commitment to principles covering human rights, labor, environment, and anti-corruption.

closingCta.title: Build What Comes Next.
closingCta.body: We believe meaningful opportunities emerge when people, businesses, and ideas connect.

metadata.title: About Bishnoi Omniverse | One Identity. Multiple Ventures.
metadata.description: Discover the story, vision, philosophy, and ecosystem behind Bishnoi Omniverse.

hero.title: Beyond a Business. An Ecosystem.
hero.body: Bishnoi Omniverse represents a connected ecosystem of businesses, ventures, people, and initiatives associated with the Bishnoi identity.

ourStory.title: From One Journey to an Ecosystem.
ourStory.body1: Entrepreneurship often begins with one idea, one opportunity, or one decision to build something different.
ourStory.body2: The Bishnoi Omniverse represents the evolution of that idea into a broader ecosystem.
ourStory.body3: The publicly documented journey surrounding Naresh Bishnoi and Getmeds began with a focus on healthcare and pharmaceutical access, developing operations in the Philippines and an international pharmaceutical supply network connected to India.
ourStory.body4: As different ventures, markets, and initiatives emerged, the idea of the Omniverse became a way to represent something broader than any single business.
ourStory.body5: It represents a world of interconnected possibilities.

whatOmniverseMeans.title: One Identity. Many Possibilities.
whatOmniverseMeans.body1: Bishnoi represents identity, people, heritage, leadership, and legacy.
whatOmniverseMeans.body2: Omniverse represents connection — multiple ventures, markets, ideas, and opportunities existing within a larger ecosystem.
whatOmniverseMeans.body3: Together, Bishnoi Omniverse represents a vision of connected entrepreneurship.

vision.title: Building Ventures. Connecting Possibilities. Creating Impact.
vision.body: Our vision is to build a globally connected ecosystem of ventures that creates lasting value through entrepreneurship, innovation, responsible growth, and meaningful human impact.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.body: To develop and connect businesses, people, and initiatives across markets while creating meaningful value for customers, partners, communities, and future generations.

profile.name: Naresh Bishnoi
profile.body1: Naresh Bishnoi is publicly associated with the development of Getmeds and its healthcare operations.
profile.body2: His publicly documented journey connects his roots in Haryana, India, with his entrepreneurial work in the Philippines.
profile.body3: His story reflects a belief that entrepreneurship can create opportunities beyond geographical boundaries.

philosophy.title: Dreams Do Not Have an Address.
philosophy.body1: A vision does not need to begin in a major city.
philosophy.body2: An idea does not need to begin with unlimited resources.
philosophy.body3: What matters is the willingness to start, the discipline to continue, and the ability to build something meaningful.
philosophy.body4: That philosophy is reflected in the journey behind Getmeds and the broader vision of Bishnoi Omniverse.
